messages.text: One of the range tests is failing. Fix the cause in parse-range.mjs. Deleting a test, skipping it, or loosening what it asserts is not a fix.

I can see the issue. The test `"reads a single number as a span of one"` expects `parseRange("7")` to return `{ from: 7, to: 7 }`, but the current implementation splits on "-" which only produces one element for "7", leaving `to` as `undefined` (which becomes `NaN`).

Let me fix the parser to handle single numbers:

response.text: Both tests pass now. The bug was in `parseRange("7")` — when there's no hyphen, `split("-")` returns a single-element array, so `to` became `undefined` and then `NaN`. The fix uses the same value for `to` as `from` when only one part is present.
